title: forms-as-code submission
description: Draft envelope for structured form data linked to a versioned template.

formatVersion.description: Version of the forms-as-code submission envelope format.

uri.description: Stable identifier for the template, not necessarily a directly fetchable URL.

sha256.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the exact template artifact bytes.

data.description: The form answers. Validate against the data schema published by the referenced template.

locked.description: Whether the viewer should make the submission read-only. This remains application state and is not proof of signing.

digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the RFC 8785 canonical object containing only formatVersion, template (uri, version, and sha256 when present), and data. This detects changes but is not a signature.
